name: Woodbridge Recreation Summer Camp
description_short: A half-day town recreation camp for grades K-8 at Beecher Road School, running 9 a.m. to noon on weekdays. The day is split into 45-minute periods of arts and crafts, drama, music, game room and athletics.

warnings: Only the 2026 season is shown, and it ended July 31, 2026, before today (2026-10-13). Dates and prices for 2027 are not published yet.

Pricing depends on how many weeks you book, not on which weeks: residents pay $500 for 1 week up to $1,000 for 6 weeks; non-residents pay $600 up to $1,100. Each extra week adds $100. Because of this, no per-session price or single weekly rate is recorded.
The page does not list the weeks one by one. The week dates were worked out from 'June 22, 2026 - July 31, 2026 (No camp on Friday, July 3) 6 weeks.'

CIT program (going into 9th grade, $1,000 resident / $1,100 non-resident) and volunteer program (going into 10th grade) require Week 1 and a 4-week minimum; these are not included in the K-8 camp sessions.
Zip 06525 comes from the Recreation Department / Town Hall address, not the Beecher Road School address.
